verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own integrations with accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite), which is the product's path for getting payroll data into a ledger. It also advertises general platform APIs spanning HR, IT and finance. Nothing in the pack shows a payroll journal endpoint, a journal export format, or agent-driven reconciliation, so support is thin and inferred. Missing for 10: documented payroll journal API/export, journal entry field and GL mapping detail, agent/programmatic reconciliation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: Integrate with industry-leading accounting systems like Xero, QuickBooks, and NetSuite.
Leverage Rippling’s unified platform and APIs to build custom apps that extend functionality across HR, IT, and finance.
